one_change.trigger: exclusive disagreement between one-nat commit-path evidence and bidirectional full-draft verification
one_change.branch: preserve all tokens shared by fast and accuracy trajectories; re-mask and top1-rediffuse only their disagreement positions
one_change.acceptance: accept the repaired draft only when the same bidirectional block verifier strictly prefers it to the pre-repair parent
one_change.code_guard: when prompt-visible checks exist, reject a repair that has fewer visible passes or loses compile validity on a pass tie

generation_inputs_allowed: checks and examples literally present in the prompt

data_lineage.humaneval_0_31: consumed development set; rapid gate only
data_lineage.humaneval_32_163: repeated-use exploratory set; never described as clean holdout
data_lineage.math_50_499: candidate-frozen suffix; no correctness inspected before freeze
data_lineage.gsm8k_64_1318: candidate-frozen suffix; no correctness inspected before freeze
data_lineage.mbpp_100_499: candidate-frozen suffix; no correctness inspected before freeze

rapid_gates.humaneval_0_31: strictly exceed v11 18/32 with positive paired gain-minus-loss
rapid_gates.mbpp_0_99: non-regressive against v11 40/100 before suffix promotion

formal_rule.accuracy: no benchmark regression and a strict aggregate gain; HumanEval full is explicitly repeated-use exploratory evidence
formal_rule.integrity: stable identity join, matching prompt and target hashes, zero duplicate or missing ids, zero residual masks, finite NFE, independent aggregate recomputation
formal_rule.fallback: if v16 fails any registered gate, keep the single v15 exact-speed framework; do not compose task-specific methods

freeze_contract: queue manifest records the source commit and sha256 hashes; no source edit after the first model stage starts
